During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], an '''Amaran bursa dealer''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] showed a [[Bursa/Legends|bursa]], a creature native to the swamps of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], to a [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]] [[Unidentified Pacithhip bursa buyer|buyer]] who was interested in reselling the beast to [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].
